info.name: Lynq BFF
info.description: Endpoints of lynq-bff, the backend-for-frontend gateway the browser talks to: it verifies the caller's JWT and relays to lynq-iam, lynq-app-backend, lynq-llm, lynq-file-storage, lynq-agent and lynq-analytics. Every request needs the `lynq-request-uuid` header (403 without it); every route except the anonymous auth ones (register, logins, check-username, check-email) also needs `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (the refresh takes the refresh token instead). Register and login auto-save `accessToken` and `refreshToken` into collection variables, and create requests save the ids later requests chain on.

exec: // Generate a fresh request UUID per call so log tracing stays unique.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Auth routes relayed to lynq-iam (`/auth`). Register, logins and availability checks are public; refresh takes the refresh token as bearer.

request.description: Public. Relays the registration to lynq-iam: creates a user with a unique username and email and the role sent in the body (R_CANDIDATE or R_COMPANY), and auto-saves the returned access/refresh tokens. Returns 201; 400 for a missing or unknown role, 409 if the username or email is taken.
Public. Authenticates with username + password through lynq-iam and saves the returned access/refresh tokens into collection variables. Returns 200; 401 on bad credentials.
Public. Authenticates with email + password through lynq-iam and saves the returned access/refresh tokens into collection variables. Returns 200; 401 on bad credentials.

Exchanges the opaque refresh token (sent as the bearer credential; the gateway skips its JWT signature check and lynq-iam validates it) for a new access token, which is saved into `accessToken`. Returns 200; 401 if the refresh token is invalid or expired.
Updates the caller's password in lynq-iam and returns a fresh access/refresh token pair, which is auto-saved into collection variables. Returns 200.
Public. Tells whether a username is still available before registering. Returns 200.
Public. Tells whether an email is still available before registering. Returns 200.

item.name: User
item.description: Candidate and user profile routes (`/user`) relayed to lynq-app-backend.

request.description: Returns the caller's own lynq-app-backend profile (including `companyId` for company users) and saves `userId`/`companyId`. Returns 200.

body.raw:
{
  "fullName": "John Doe",
  "currentPosition": "Backend Developer",
  "about": "Backend developer who enjoys building APIs.",
  "githubUrl": "https://github.com/johndoe-example",
  "linkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/johndoe-example",
  "birthDate": "1995-05-20"
}

request.description: Creates the caller's profile in lynq-app-backend after registering and saves its id into `userId`. Returns 201.

body.raw:
{
  "fullName": "John Doe",
  "currentPosition": "Senior Backend Developer",
  "about": "Backend developer focused on distributed systems.",
  "githubUrl": "https://github.com/johndoe-example",
  "linkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/johndoe-example",
  "birthDate": "1995-05-20",
  "expectedSalary": 3000,
  "expectedSalaryCurrency": "USD"
}

request.description: Partially updates the caller's profile, including the expected salary. Returns 200.
Returns a pre-signed URL to upload the caller's profile image and the `fileId` to confirm it with, saved into `imageFileId`. Returns 200.
Confirms that the profile image was uploaded to the pre-signed URL and attaches it to the caller's profile. Returns 204 with no body.
Returns a pre-signed URL to upload a resume document and the `fileId` to confirm or import it with, saved into `resumeFileId`. Returns 200.
Confirms that the resume document was uploaded to the pre-signed URL. Returns 204 with no body.
Lists the caller's stored resumes (id, name, alias, language, content, PDF URL). Returns 200.
Lists the languages a resume can be stored or translated in (lynq-app-backend's supported_languages). Returns 200.
Stores a structured resume for the caller and saves its id into `resumeId`. `language` is one of EN, ES, FR, PR; `fileId` optionally links an uploaded document. Returns 201.
Renames one of the caller's resumes by setting its alias, relayed straight to lynq-app-backend. Returns 200; 404 if the resume is not the caller's.
Deletes one of the caller's resumes in lynq-app-backend and returns the deleted resume's summary. Returns 200 (with a body, unlike DELETE /resume/{resumeId}); 404 if it is not the caller's.
Pages through the job applications the caller has made. Returns 200.

Asks lynq-app-backend for the courses and skills the caller should work on to fit the given job post. `language` defaults to `en`. Returns 200. Rate limited per user in tier STANDARD (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.standard`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).
Returns the public profile of any user by id (with its company and job data when it has them). Returns 200; 404 if the user does not exist.

body.raw:
{
  "fullName": "Jane Doe",
  "currentPosition": "Head of Talent",
  "userAbout": "Recruiting engineers for Example Corp.",
  "linkedinUrl": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/janedoe-example",
  "birthDate": "1990-01-15",
  "companyName": "Example Corp",
  "companyAbout": "A fictional software company used for testing.",
  "companySize": 50
}

request.description: Creates the caller's user profile together with the company it owns and saves the new `companyId`. Returns 201.
Partially updates the company the caller owns. Returns 200.
Returns a pre-signed URL to upload the company logo and the `fileId` to confirm it with, saved into `imageFileId`. Returns 200.
Confirms that the company logo was uploaded to the pre-signed URL and attaches it to the company. Returns 204 with no body.
Returns a company's detail by id. Returns 200; 404 if it does not exist.

item.name: Job
item.description: Job post routes (`/job`) relayed to lynq-app-backend.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Backend Developer",
  "description": "We are looking for a backend developer with Java and Spring Boot experience.",
  "workType": "REMOTE",
  "salaryRangeDown": 2000,
  "salaryRangeTop": 3500,
  "salaryCurrency": "USD",
  "jobPostSource": "LYNQ",
  "skills": [
    "Java",
    "Spring Boot",
    "SQL"
  ],
  "similarityTags": [
    "java",
    "spring boot",
    "backend"
  ]
}

request.description: Publishes a job post for the caller's company and saves its id into `jobId`. `workType` is REMOTE or IN_OFFICE; `jobPostSource` is LYNQ, LINKEDIN, COMPUTRABAJO or BUMERAN. Returns 201.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Senior Backend Developer",
  "description": "We are looking for a senior backend developer with Java and Spring Boot experience.",
  "workType": "REMOTE",
  "status": "OPEN",
  "salaryRangeDown": 3000,
  "salaryRangeTop": 4500,
  "salaryCurrency": "USD",
  "skills": [
    "Java",
    "Spring Boot",
    "SQL",
    "Kafka"
  ],
  "similarityTags": [
    "java",
    "spring boot",
    "backend"
  ]
}

request.description: Partially updates a job post the caller's company owns; `status` is OPEN or CLOSE. Returns 200.
Pages through job posts, optionally filtered by `filterValue` (free text). `page` defaults to 0 and `size` to 10. Returns 200.
Pages through the job posts published by the caller's company. Returns 200.
Returns the full detail of a job post. Returns 200; 404 if it does not exist.
Counts one more view of the job post and returns the new total. Returns 200.
Refreshes a job post the caller's company owns, resetting its creation date and status. Returns 200.
Closes a job post the caller's company owns so it stops taking applications. Returns 200.
Applies the caller to a job post with one of their stored resumes (`resumeId`), or with an already-uploaded PDF (`fileId`, optional). Returns 201.
Pages through the candidates who applied to a job post of the caller's company, with their Lynq score, and saves the first candidate's user id into `candidateId`. Returns 200.

Asks the LLM, through lynq-app-backend, why a candidate (by user id) does or does not fit the job post. Returns 200; 404 if that user did not apply. Rate limited per user in tier STANDARD (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.standard`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Asks the LLM, through lynq-app-backend, which courses and skills would make the caller a better fit for the job post. `language` defaults to `en`. Returns 200. Rate limited per user in tier STANDARD (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.standard`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

item.name: Resume
item.description: Resume orchestration routes (`/resume`), all restricted to R_CANDIDATE: preview, import, translation, alias, deletion and the CV Tailor conversation.

request.description: Renders a resume into a PDF with the chosen template (MODERN or CLASSIC) and returns its `fileId` and a download URL; the `fileId` is saved into `previewFileId`. Returns 201. Requires role R_CANDIDATE (`@HasRole(Role.CANDIDATE)`); any other role gets 403. Rate limited per user in tier STANDARD (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.standard`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Confirms an uploaded resume document (from GET /user/generate-upload-resume), parses it with the LLM and stores it as a new resume, whose id is saved into `resumeId`. `language` (default EN) is the fallback when the language cannot be detected. Returns 201; 502 if the import fails. Requires role R_CANDIDATE (`@HasRole(Role.CANDIDATE)`); any other role gets 403. Rate limited per user in tier HEAVY (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.heavy`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Translates one of the caller's stored resumes into another supported language and stores the result as a new resume (the response carries it). Returns 200; 400 if the language is unsupported or the caller already holds a resume in it. Requires role R_CANDIDATE (`@HasRole(Role.CANDIDATE)`); any other role gets 403. Rate limited per user in tier HEAVY (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.heavy`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).
Deletes a preview PDF produced by POST /resume/preview. Returns 204 with no body. Requires role R_CANDIDATE (`@HasRole(Role.CANDIDATE)`); any other role gets 403.

Assigns the alias the candidate wants one of their resumes known by. Returns 200; 404 if the resume is not the caller's. Requires role R_CANDIDATE (`@HasRole(Role.CANDIDATE)`); any other role gets 403.

Deletes one of the caller's resumes together with its stored files. Returns 204 with no body; 404 if the resume is not the caller's. Requires role R_CANDIDATE (`@HasRole(Role.CANDIDATE)`); any other role gets 403.

Starts a CV Tailor conversation in lynq-agent that adapts a stored resume to a job post, and saves the returned `conversationId`. `language` (default EN) is the conversation language. Returns 201. Requires role R_CANDIDATE (`@HasRole(Role.CANDIDATE)`); any other role gets 403. Rate limited per user in tier HEAVY (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.heavy`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Sends one message to the CV Tailor conversation and returns the agent's reply and the updated resume. `turnKey` is an idempotency key: retrying with the same key returns the same turn. Returns 200. Requires role R_CANDIDATE (`@HasRole(Role.CANDIDATE)`); any other role gets 403. Rate limited per user in tier HEAVY (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.heavy`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Returns the CV Tailor conversation with its messages and current resume. Returns 200; 404 if it is not the caller's. Requires role R_CANDIDATE (`@HasRole(Role.CANDIDATE)`); any other role gets 403. Rate limited per user in tier LIGHT (30/minute, 500/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.light`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Renders the tailored resume (template defaults to MODERN, `resumeName` to the posting title), applies to the conversation's job post with it and closes the conversation. `fileId` optionally reuses a PDF already rendered for this conversation. Returns 201. Requires role R_CANDIDATE (`@HasRole(Role.CANDIDATE)`); any other role gets 403. Rate limited per user in tier STANDARD (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.standard`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).
Registers a file in lynq-file-storage and returns a pre-signed upload URL; the new `fileId` is saved into `fileId`. Returns 201.
Marks a file the caller owns as uploaded (PENDING to AVAILABLE) and returns it. Returns 200.
Returns the metadata of a file the caller owns. Returns 200; 404 if it is not the caller's.
Returns a pre-signed download URL for a file the caller owns. Returns 200.
Returns a map of fileId to pre-signed download URL for several files at once. Returns 200.
Deletes a file the caller owns. Returns 204 with no body.

item.name: LLM
item.description: lynq-llm generations relayed by the gateway (no path prefix).

request.description: Asks lynq-llm to suggest skills for a job post from its title, description and work type (`work_type` is REMOTE or IN_OFFICE). Returns 200. Rate limited per user in tier STANDARD (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.standard`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Asks lynq-llm to translate a resume sent in the body into `language` and returns the translated resume without storing it. Returns 200. Rate limited per user in tier HEAVY (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.heavy`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Asks lynq-llm which language a text is written in. Returns 200. Rate limited per user in tier LIGHT (30/minute, 500/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.light`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Asks lynq-llm to extract the skills of a resume sent as the raw body. `language` is optional. Returns 200. Rate limited per user in tier STANDARD (10/minute, 200/day, `lynq.rate-limit.tiers.standard`); when the quota runs out it answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

item.name: LLM (refused)
item.description: lynq-llm routes the gateway maps only to refuse them: they always answer 403, for any HTTP method.

request.description: Always answers 403: this lynq-llm evaluation is built from lynq-backend's data and is only reachable through the job endpoints (use GET /job/{jobId}/upskilling-suggestion or GET /user/upskilling-suggestion/{jobPostId}). Mapped for every HTTP method.

Always answers 403: this lynq-llm evaluation is built from lynq-backend's data and is only reachable through the job endpoints (use GET /job/{jobId}/candidate/{candidateId}/candidate-explanation). Mapped for every HTTP method.
Always answers 403: this lynq-llm endpoint fetches a caller-supplied URL server-side, so the gateway does not relay it (use POST /resume/document/{fileId}/import). Mapped for every HTTP method.

Always answers 403: this lynq-llm endpoint fetches a caller-supplied URL server-side, so the gateway does not relay it (use POST /resume/preview, which signs those URLs itself). Mapped for every HTTP method.
Returns time-to-fill analytics (median, p25/p75, days open) for a job post from lynq-analytics. Returns 200.
Returns the caller's standing among a job post's applicants (rank, percentile, score vs median) from lynq-analytics. Returns 200.
Returns the salary distribution of the position and of peers' expected salaries for a job post from lynq-analytics. Returns 200.
Returns the caller's market-fit benchmark as a candidate against peers, with skill unlocks and history, from lynq-analytics. Returns 200.
Returns market analytics (open posts, skill demand, salaries, posts published per week) from lynq-analytics, optionally in a given `currency`. Returns 200.
Returns analytics for every job post of the caller's company from lynq-analytics. Returns 200.
